assessment_summary:
I validated the Nebu (Matrix-compatible chat server) installation against Installation.md by inspecting containers, endpoints, database state, and — critically — re-running the functional flows live rather than trusting the summary.

WHAT I INSPECTED/VERIFIED:
1. Stack (guide §2): All 5 runtime containers (server, postgres, dex, minio, clamav) up and healthy; createbuckets exited 0. Endpoints on the documented ports all respond: Matrix API + health on :8008 and :4000, admin UI on :8080, Dex on :5556, MinIO S3/console on :9000/:9001, Postgres on :5432 (queried via docker exec psql -U nebu -d nebu).
2. /etc/hosts (guide §3): '127.0.0.1 dex' present.
3. Bootstrap Wizard (guide §4): Postgres server_config shows bootstrap_completed=true, instance_name=localhost, oidc_issuer=http://dex:5556/dex, oidc_client_id=nebu-gateway, admin_group_claim=instance_admin (path groups). Unauthenticated /admin/dashboard and /admin/bootstrap both 302-redirect to /admin/login (bootstrap permanently disabled), and /admin/login renders the SSO page — exactly the locked state the guide describes.
4. SSO login (guide §5), re-executed fresh by me during validation: full Matrix SSO redirect -> Dex authorization-code+PKCE flow -> Dex password login (kai@example.com/changeme) -> redirect back with loginToken -> POST m.login.token -> 200 with a signed JWT (aud=nebu-gateway, groups=[instance_admin], email claim) -> whoami = @kai:localhost. Second accounts (@alex, @tom) tokens also valid via whoami.
5. Matrix functionality (guide §5 test room/messaging): room !fecb8580371b5f46:localhost exists with both members joined and alex's message retrievable via /messages; /sync returns 200; media upload+download round-trip through MinIO returns the identical 67-byte PNG.
6. Admin SSO: /admin/login/start -> Dex -> login kai -> /admin/dashboard renders 200; session cookie keeps dashboard accessible.

DEVIATIONS NOTED (from the installation summary, not new failures): (a) Docker Hub blocked minio images, so the attempt built local images from sha256-verified official MinIO binaries — the resulting minio container is healthy and functionally proven by the media round-trip, so this is an acceptable environment workaround, not a defect. (b) The guide's OIDC client values (nebu-admin/nebu-admin-secret) don't match the shipped code (which registers nebu-gateway); the attempt correctly used the code's canonical values, confirmed by the successful SSO JWT (aud=nebu-gateway). (c) The guide's 'Nebu.Application started' log line is absent, but the equivalent 'Running Nebu.Web.Router with Bandit 1.12.0' + 34 migrations + 200 health checks confirm the server started.

LIMITATIONS: I did not drive a real browser (Element Web) for the visual SSO flow — instead I reproduced the identical underlying HTTP/OIDC sequence with curl, which is the same protocol the browser would perform; the admin dashboard and SSO pages render correctly, so browser-only rendering differences are the only untested surface. mc listing of the nebu-media bucket with app creds returns Access Denied, which is expected least-privilege policy (object-level grants); the authoritative media test (upload/download via the Matrix API) passed.

CONCLUSION: Objective, live evidence shows every documented step — prerequisites, stack up, hosts entry, bootstrap wizard completion + lock, SSO Matrix login, and two-account room messaging — is in effect and functioning. The installation is complete and operational per the guide: SUCCESS.
